title: AW28 Men's Knit Fabric Direction
summary: AW28 men's knits: fine merino, brushed wool, cashmere blends.
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 fabric fairs take place in September 2027 and the shows in early 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fabric fairs, SS28 previews and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- AW27 fairs made wool lighter and softer, brought back double-faced woollens and hid performance inside classic suitings<sup>[1]</sup>
- "Marinated midtones": honey brown, mustard yellow, turquoise, lime, retro orange and a brown-burgundy, with "pickled fennel" as an anchor colour<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Fabric by fabric
sections.body:
| Knit | Hand | Uses |
|---|---|---|
| Fine merino | Smooth | Turtlenecks |
| Brushed wool | Hairy | Crews |
| Cashmere blend | Soft | Knit jackets |

design_implications: - Test pilling, stretch recovery and colour fastness.
